label: short Lamassu system
definition: A Lamassu system in which an organism possesses a locus from the short-LmuB family, characterized by shorter coiled-coil regions in its SMC-like LmuB sensor than in long Lamassu systems.
observations: Short-LmuB structural family, not a length bin or a type-I synonym. Parent of traitmech:000568 (v445 METPO:1052200); carry that additional subclass relation into the upstream ontology on minting.
